fullstack.title: Senior / Staff Fullstack Software Engineer
lanes: Senior / Staff Fullstack Software Engineer
We're looking for a Senior or Staff Fullstack Engineer who enjoys owning a feature all the way from the browser to the services behind it.

You'll work across a modern React and TypeScript application, Python and Rust services, external APIs, and an AI agent platform. The role has a strong front-end focus, but this isn't a position where you throw an API request over the wall and wait for someone else to deal with the rest.

You'll be expected to understand the complete journey of the data: how it reaches the application, how agents and services process it, how results are streamed back, and ultimately how those results become a fast and intuitive experience for the user.
You'll also work closely with machine learning engineers to turn sophisticated AI capabilities into practical product features people can actually use.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who likes difficult product problems, takes ownership and cares about the quality of what reaches production.
What you'll be doing
Own features from concept through production across React/TypeScript, Python and Rust.
Build responsive and high-performance user experiences using React and TypeScript, with particular attention to component architecture, state management and browser performance.
Integrate AI agents and machine learning services into real product workflows, turning complex underlying capabilities into simple user experiences.
Contribute to Python and Rust services responsible for business logic, data exchange, agent orchestration and communication with the client application.
Design and evolve API contracts alongside platform and backend engineers, making sure services provide the data and behaviour the application needs.
Integrate third-party platforms and APIs while accounting for authentication, rate limits, retries, latency and failures.
Work with streaming and real-time data, ensuring results are delivered reliably and efficiently to the browser.
Investigate performance across the entire application, from browser memory and rendering through API calls and backend services.
Collaborate directly with product managers, designers, ML engineers and other software engineers to turn ideas into clearly defined features.
Write maintainable, well-tested code, contribute to code reviews and improve areas of the codebase that need attention.
What we're looking for
You've already worked at Senior or Staff level building sophisticated web applications used in production.
You should have:
Strong React and TypeScript experience, including complex component architecture, state management and performance optimisation.
Experience working with WebAssembly in the browser, including integrating WASM modules with JavaScript or TypeScript and diagnosing performance issues across that boundary.
Experience integrating LLMs, AI agents or similar AI services into production applications.
An understanding of the realities of AI-powered applications, including streaming responses, tool calls, unpredictable latency, errors and partial results.
Experience integrating external APIs and designing around authentication, rate limiting, retries and service failures.
Strong debugging skills across the stack. You should be comfortable following a problem from the browser, through network requests and backend services, into infrastructure logs.
Good knowledge of front-end architecture and patterns for building complex, stateful applications.
Production experience with at least one of our backend languages: Python or Rust.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of your normal engineering workflow.
The communication skills to work effectively across engineering, product, design and machine learning teams.
Most importantly, you should be comfortable joining an evolving product and codebase where not every problem has already been neatly defined.
Nice to have
Experience in any of these areas would be particularly useful:
2D or 3D graphics, CAD or geometry-heavy applications.
WebGL, WebGPU or Three.js.
AWS infrastructure and managed services.
Production observability, including logging, tracing and monitoring.
CI/CD and GitLab pipelines.
Agile product development.
The kind of engineer who will enjoy this role
You probably won't enjoy this position if you want to work exclusively on isolated front-end tickets.

You probably will if you like understanding how the whole product works, are willing to move between React, APIs, backend services and AI systems, and enjoy taking responsibility for getting something from an idea to a polished feature in production.
The problems are technically challenging, the product is ambitious, and you'll have the opportunity to influence how both the application and its engineering architecture evolve.

ml.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
lanes: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Future opportunities / Brazil / Remote
We're building our network of exceptional Senior Machine Learning Engineers based in Brazil for upcoming opportunities with international technology companies.

AI and machine learning engineering is currently one of the areas where we're seeing the highest demand from our clients. While this application is not tied to a specific open position, we're interviewing strong candidates now so that we can move quickly when suitable roles become available.

The opportunities we typically work on involve building production AI systems at scale, using advanced machine learning, large language models and intelligent automation to solve complex, real-world problems.
What you could be working on
Building and developing AI platforms involving search, retrieval and multi-agent orchestration.
Designing and implementing multi-agent architectures, defining how specialist agents interact to solve complex tasks.
Designing, building and optimising large-scale document processing pipelines, including ingestion, parsing, chunking, indexing and structured data extraction.
Improving search and retrieval capabilities through ranking, query understanding and AI-powered question answering.
Building and maintaining knowledge graphs and other graph-based systems to improve reasoning and retrieval.
Taking ownership of high-impact AI projects from concept and experimentation through to production.
Developing evaluation frameworks and experimentation processes to measure model performance and continuously improve quality.
Writing clean, scalable, production-ready code and contributing to strong engineering practices.
About you
We're interested in experienced engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems and turning AI research and experimentation into reliable production systems.
You'll ideally have:
7+ years of experience designing, building and deploying production-grade machine learning or AI systems.
A proven ability to lead technically challenging projects with meaningful business impact.
Strong experience building LLM-powered applications, AI agents or orchestration frameworks.
Deep knowledge of document processing pipelines, including parsing, chunking, indexing and structured information extraction.
Experience working with distributed systems and technologies such as Kubernetes.
Knowledge of knowledge graphs, provenance graphs or similar graph-based data models.
Strong software engineering skills in Python, Go or similar languages.
Experience in one or more of the following areas is particularly relevant:
Search and ranking systems
Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Recommendation systems
Large-scale ML infrastructure
Experience within construction, engineering, AEC or other document-intensive industries is also valuable.
Why apply now?
We're interviewing engineers in Brazil now to build a shortlist for future international opportunities.

By completing our process in advance, we'll already understand your technical background, experience, English level and career goals. When a suitable opportunity becomes available, we can contact you directly and potentially move much faster through the hiring process.
If you're an experienced Machine Learning Engineer based in Brazil and interested in working remotely with international technology companies, we'd like to hear from you.

qa.title: Senior Software Test Automation Engineer (AI-Driven)
lanes: Senior Software Test Automation Engineer (AI-Driven)
Before you apply
You must be physically located in Brazil
CVs must be submitted in English
Good spoken English is required
About

Join a team building sophisticated engineering software where quality is treated as a core feature, not an afterthought. You'll take ownership of the test automation strategy, designing robust frameworks that ensure complex web and desktop applications remain reliable as they evolve. You'll also explore how modern AI tools can accelerate testing, reduce manual effort, and improve overall software quality.
What You'll Do
Design and implement scalable automation frameworks for modern web and desktop applications.
Create and maintain automated tests across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end layers.
Build reliable, reusable test suites for interactive 3D browser applications.
Transform product requirements into comprehensive automated test scenarios.
Develop and optimise CI/CD pipelines to ensure fast and reliable releases.
Use AI-assisted development tools to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.
Create performance and load testing solutions to measure application scalability.
Investigate test failures, eliminate flaky tests, and continuously improve automation stability.
Work closely with software engineers, technical leads, and QA specialists to identify the highest-value automation opportunities.
Contribute to monitoring and quality metrics by building dashboards and actionable reporting.
What We're Looking For
8+ years' experience in Software Test Engineering, SDET, or Test Automation.
Expert knowledge of Playwright and TypeScript.
Strong experience testing modern React applications.
Solid understanding of testing strategies across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing.
Experience designing automation frameworks rather than simply maintaining existing ones.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar.
Strong understanding of web technologies, REST APIs, browser behaviour, and debugging tools.
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent.
Excellent JavaScript/TypeScript skills.
Nice to Have
Experience testing applications built with Three.js, WebGL, or other 3D rendering technologies.
Knowledge of performance, stress, or load testing.
Experience writing automation in Rust or C#.
Exposure to CAD or engineering software such as Revit or Rhino.
Experience testing .NET desktop applications, plugins, or native software.
Previous experience helping scale QA practices across multiple products or engineering teams.
Why Join Us?

You'll work on technically challenging products where automation is central to the development process. You'll have the opportunity to influence testing strategy, adopt cutting-edge AI tools, and help shape the quality standards for software used by engineering professionals around the world.
